categories.main_business_segments: EVE Energy Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: consumer batteries (including lithium primary batteries, small lithium-ion batteries, and cylindrical batteries), power batteries (for new energy vehicles and battery systems), and energy storage batteries. These segments cover a wide range of applications from consumer electronics and IoT devices to electric vehicles and large-scale energy storage systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced lithium battery technologies including lithium primary batteries, soft-pack lithium-ion batteries, cylindrical lithium-ion batteries, and prismatic lithium iron phosphate and ternary batteries. It emphasizes high energy density, safety, long cycle life, and fast charging capabilities. Manufacturing is highly automated and digitized, with global production bases and R&D centers supporting innovation in solid-state batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and hydrogen fuel cells.
categories.primary_customers_markets: EVE Energy serves diverse markets including smart metering, automotive electronics, smart security, wearable devices, electric tools, electric two-wheelers, clean appliances, and portable energy storage. Its power batteries cater to new energy passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and engineering machinery, while energy storage batteries target power grid storage, commercial and residential storage, telecom backup, data centers, and marine power applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with production and R&D facilities in Guangdong, Hubei, Qinghai, and other provinces. It has expanded internationally with manufacturing bases in Malaysia, Hungary, the United States, Ireland, and Singapore, serving global markets including Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: EVE Energy is positioned as an integrated lithium battery platform leader, covering upstream raw material procurement (nickel, cobalt, lithium), midstream battery material production, cell manufacturing, and downstream battery pack and system integration. It also engages in battery recycling and reuse, forming a full lifecycle and green supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development driven by technological innovation, focusing on new product development in lithium metal secondary batteries, semi-solid-state batteries, solid-state polymer batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and hydrogen fuel cells. It invests heavily in R&D with a large team and advanced facilities, aiming to enhance battery safety, energy density, fast charging, and cost competitiveness while advancing digital manufacturing and global capacity expansion.
categories.revenue_model: EVE Energy generates revenue primarily through direct sales of lithium battery products across its consumer, power, and energy storage segments. It also earns income from licensing and strategic partnerships, including joint ventures and technology cooperation agreements, and receives government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the lithium battery industry, ranking first domestically in lithium primary battery sales and exports, among the top four globally in cylindrical battery shipments, fourth in China's power battery market share, and third globally in energy storage battery shipments. It competes with major Chinese and international battery manufacturers and has established partnerships with top automotive and energy companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, EVE Energy achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 48.78 billion, a 34.38% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 4.05 billion, up 15.42%. The company’s power battery shipments reached 28.08 GWh (64.22% growth), and energy storage battery shipments hit 26.29 GWh (121.14% growth). It maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EVE Energy emphasizes its comprehensive lithium battery technology platform, combining safety, reliability, high performance, and cost efficiency. Its differentiated products include high-capacity large cylindrical batteries, advanced energy storage solutions, and specialized medical batteries. The company’s digitalized manufacturing, global footprint, and integrated supply chain provide competitive advantages in quality, innovation, and responsiveness to diverse customer needs.
